Кверцетин.about: Flavonoid: moderately reduces systolic blood pressure; the effect on endurance is trivial.
Кверцетин.caution: Quercetin is a flavonoid from onions/apples. For blood pressure: a meta-analysis (35948195) shows a moderate decrease. For cardiometabolic factors: improvement of markers (umbrella review 37654199). For endurance: data available (22805526). For hyperuricemia/gout: data available (41514376). Bioavailability is low - forms with enhancers (piperine, phospholipids) are needed. Dose: 500-1000 mg/day.
effects: Allergy/ARI: not confirmed in humans (not confirmed)
Кверцетин.food_sources: Onions, apples, tea, capers; bioavailability is low - working dose from the supplement.
Кверцетин.guidelines: Umbrella 2023 (5 MA): SBP −1.9 mm, insulin −1.07; MA 2022: SBP −2.4, in (pre)hypertensive patients DBP −3.1.
Кверцетин.how_to_choose: 500–1000 mg/day with piperine (bioavailability); with pressure - not instead of, but along with treatment.
mechs: SBP −1.9–2.4 mmHg; DBP only in (pre)hyper. subgroup −3.1
BO2max +1.9%, EP +0.7%; “trivial” for trained and untrained (n=288)
Кверцетин.myths: “Treats allergies” - stabilization of mast cells only in vitro. “Increases endurance” - BO2max +1.9%, but “trivial” for amateurs (MA 2013).
Кверцетин.name: Quercetin
Кверцетин.onset: Effect on blood pressure - course, weeks of admission; There is no ergogenic “at a time”.
Кверцетин.title: Quercetin
Кверцетин.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Кверцетин.who_needs: Increased SBP as a mild supplement; hyperuricemia/gout - data available; Allergy/ARI - no.
